rules.name: Known cryptominer binary executed
rules.description: xmrig, minerd, cpuminer, xmr-stak, ethminer, t-rex, lolminer, kdevtmpfsi or kinsing started.

rules.name: Miner pool or algorithm arguments
rules.description: A command with a stratum URL, --donate-level or a mining --algo value.

rules.name: Connection to a public mining pool
rules.description: Destination names of well-known Monero/Ethereum/other pools.

rules.name: Several services stopped in one command
rules.description: Three or more chained systemctl stop/disable/kill calls, typical pre-encryption or wiper prep.

positive.command: systemctl stop mysql; systemctl stop nginx; systemctl stop redis
systemctl disable a && systemctl disable b && systemctl disable c

negative.command: systemctl stop a; systemctl start a

rules.name: ESXi virtual machines force-killed
rules.description: esxcli vm process kill with force/hard type or vim-cmd power off/destroy over many VMs.

rules.name: Snapshots or logical volumes destroyed
rules.description: lvremove -f/-y, zfs destroy of a snapshot, btrfs subvolume delete, timeshift/snapper delete.

rules.name: Shell fork bomb
rules.description: The classic :(){ :|:& };: function bomb or a function-recursion variant.

rules.name: Kernel sysrq crash or power-off trigger
rules.description: Writing c, o or b to /proc/sysrq-trigger crashes, powers off or reboots immediately.
